name: TicLabs AI Content Hub
author: tomich78

sections.description:
TicLabs AI Content Hub is a powerful WordPress plugin that integrates artificial intelligence capabilities directly into your WordPress site. Generate high-quality content, stunning images, and optimize your SEO—all without leaving your dashboard.

Key Features

  • Multi-Provider Support: Not limited to OpenAI and DALL-E. Integrate with multiple AI providers:

    • OpenAI (GPT-4.1 Mini, GPT-4.1 Nano, GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, Dall-E 3)
    • Google AI (Gemini)
    • Anthropic Claude
    • Stability AI
    • Cohere AI
    • Mistral AI
    • HuggingFace AI
    • Perplexity
    • OpenRouter
    • Others: AI21 Labs Jamba, Together AI, GRoq, Nebius, Cerebras, Fireworks, Upstage, Baseten, SambaNova Cloud, DeepSeek, Hyperbolic, MagicHour AI, deAPI.ai, ImaginePro AI, Replicate, Leonardo AI, Segmind, Runwayml, FAL.ai, …

  • Content Generation

    • Generate blog posts, articles, and landing pages
    • Create product descriptions and marketing copy
    • Optimize existing content for SEO
    • Generate meta titles and descriptions
    • Create social media content
    • Support for multiple languages

  • Image Generation

    • Generate images from text descriptions
    • Multiple style presets (photorealistic, artistic, minimalist, etc.)
    • Custom image sizes and aspect ratios
    • Support for multiple image providers

Getting Started

1. Configure Your AI Provider

  1. Go to TicLabs AI Content Hub > Settings
  2. Choose your AI provider (OpenAI, Google AI, Anthropic, or custom provider)
  3. Enter your API key securely

2. Add API Keys

  1. Get your API key from your chosen provider:

    • OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
    • Google AI: https://makersuite.google.com/app/apikey
    • Anthropic: https://console.anthropic.com/
    • Stability AI: https://platform.stability.ai/
    • Custom Provider: Contact your provider for credentials

  2. Go to TicLabs AI Content Hub > Settings

  3. Click Add New Key
  4. Select provider, paste your key, and save securely

3. Generate Your First Content

  1. Go to TicLabs AI Content Hub > Generate Content
  2. Select a Provider
  3. Select content type (Blog Post, Page, Product Description, Meta Description, Title)
  4. Enter your prompt in Description field.
  5. Click Generate Content
  6. Review and edit the generated content
  7. Copy to clipboard

4. Generate Images

  1. Go to TicLabs AI Content Hub > Generate Images
  2. Select a Provider
  3. Enter your image description
  4. Select a image size
  5. Click Generate Image
  6. You will be able to find the generated image in the Media Library.

Content Templates

The plugin includes ready-to-use templates for:

  • Blog Posts
  • Pages
  • Product Descriptions

Security & Privacy

  • API Keys: Never logged or displayed
  • Data: No content sent to third parties except configured providers
  • Permissions: Content Hub only visible to users with appropriate capabilities
  • Nonces: All forms protected against CSRF attacks
  • Sanitization: All user input properly sanitized

External Services

This plugin connects to multiple third-party AI service providers to generate content (text and images).
These external services are required to provide the core functionality of generating AI-powered content within WordPress.

Data Sent: User-provided prompts, selected settings (model, temperature, max tokens, etc.), and API keys provided by the user.
When: Data is sent only when the user explicitly requests content generation through the plugin interface.
User Control: Users can disable specific providers or choose which service to use. No automatic requests are made.

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

“Invalid API Key”
– Verify API key is correct and not expired
– Check provider is selected correctly
– Ensure API key has necessary permissions
– Try regenerating API key from provider

“Rate limit exceeded”
– Wait before making new requests
– Upgrade API plan for higher limits
– Configure rate limiting in plugin settings
– Check provider dashboard for usage

“Connection timeout”
– Check internet connection
– Verify provider API is online (check status page)
– Try alternative provider

“Memory limit exceeded”
– Increase PHP memory_limit in wp-config.php
– Clear plugin cache
– Upgrade hosting plan

“No response from provider”
– Verify network firewall allows outbound requests
– Check provider’s status and availability

sections.installation:
From WordPress.org

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “TicLabs AI Content Hub”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Extract the ZIP file to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Go to Plugins in your WordPress dashboard
  4. Find TicLabs AI Content Hub and click Activate

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress: 6.X or higher
  • PHP: 8.0 or higher
  • PHP Extensions: curl, json
sections.faq:
Which AI providers offer free tiers?

Several AI providers integrated into TicLabs AI Content Hub offer free or generous free tiers:

Text Generation:
– Google Gemini – Free tier with 60 requests per minute for Gemini 2.5 Flash.
– Anthropic Claude – Limited free access through Claude.ai (API requires paid account, but Claude Haiku 4.1 is the most cost-effective option at 🪙).
– HuggingFace – Free hosting and inference for open-source models like Flux.1 Dev and GPT-OSS variants.
– Groq – Free API access with community tier available.
– Together AI – Free credits for new users plus open-source model hosting.
– Upstage Solar – Competitive free-tier options for lightweight applications.

Image Generation:
– HuggingFace – Free inference for Flux.1 Dev model with community access.
– DeAPI.ai – Free tier available for Flux.1 Schnell with limited daily requests.
– Stability AI – Free credits for new accounts to test Stable Diffusion 3.5.

Best Free Options:
– Maximum free value: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (text) + HuggingFace Flux.1 Dev (images).

Most generous free tier: HuggingFace ecosystem with community models.

Important Note: Free tiers typically have rate limits, request quotas, or feature limitations. For production use or high-volume generation, consider upgrading to paid plans. Check each provider’s documentation for current free tier terms and limits.

Can I use multiple providers simultaneously?

Yes! Configure multiple providers and choose which to use for each generation.

Is my data private?

Yes. Only configured providers receive your content. Check each provider’s privacy policy. No data is stored on TicLabs Servers.

Can I generate content in multiple languages?

Yes. Supported languages depend on your AI provider. Most support 100+ languages. The generated content’s language will be determined by whatever language the AI provider detects from your input description.

What about copyright concerns?

AI-generated content is your responsibility. Always review and customize. Check AI provider’s terms regarding content ownership.

Can I use this commercially?

Yes, for commercial use follow your chosen AI provider’s terms.

Does it work with multisite?

Yes, fully multisite compatible. Configure per-site or network-wide.

Can I customize generated content?

Absolutely. All content is fully editable after generation.

Important Notes

  • User Control: Users can select which AI provider to use and can disable any provider they don’t want to use.
  • API Keys: Users must provide their own API keys for most services. The plugin does not store API keys on our servers.
  • Data Privacy: We recommend reviewing each service’s privacy policy to understand how your data is handled.
  • No Automatic Requests: The plugin does NOT make automatic requests to any external service. Requests are only made when the user explicitly initiates content generation.
  • Disclaimer: This plugin is independently developed and is not affiliated with any of the AI service providers listed above.

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

“Invalid API Key”
– Verify API key is correct and not expired
– Check provider is selected correctly
– Ensure API key has necessary permissions
– Try regenerating API key from provider

“Rate limit exceeded”
– Wait before making new requests
– Upgrade API plan for higher limits
– Configure rate limiting in plugin settings
– Check provider dashboard for usage

“Connection timeout”
– Check internet connection
– Verify provider API is online (check status page)
– Try alternative provider

“Memory limit exceeded”
– Increase PHP memory_limit in wp-config.php
– Clear plugin cache
– Upgrade hosting plan

“No response from provider”
– Verify network firewall allows outbound requests
– Check provider’s status and availability
